headline: Co-op fixes, easier level editing and environment reflections reach develop
summary: Players get working Drone Device spawns on PAL and NTSC-U and repaired Novalis sparks (#110). Level creators can follow one launcher panel from extraction through packing and play, or reset their editor files with confirmation (#105, #107). Enhanced rendering adds baked reflections for water and authored chrome and glass, with better lighting-probe placement around playable spaces (#119).
highlights: Custom ship destinations and static imports landed through #104, but the original #101 describes PAL-only support and says manual gameplay testing was not completed. NTSC-U destination support remained follow-up work.

Co-op menus no longer empty or stop the party's world (#99), and remote gloves animate with their hands (#120). SDK 1.10 supports persistent savestates for the same build and disc via external mods (#103).
SDK 1.10.1 adds Android native-mod builds (#117, #118). Installed editor tools preserve typed object-parameter edits (#100).
Fresh pad input and low-latency frames are optional and off by default (#122). NTSC-U save overwrites work again, and Exit text and the chosen language survive Quit Game (#121, #126).
Development-channel updates now follow develop (#111). Camera validation landed after a reported NTSC-U 0.9.0 travel black screen that the author could not reproduce (#114).
#119 accounts for 19,210 of the day's 38,239 added lines. Mod-update offers, saved mod links, modded-save marks and pad bindings were proposed in #123, with no landing recorded today.
